data_point: Controller, Head of Finance or finance team present (mid-size and up)

prompt.task: Decide whether the company has a Controller, Head of Finance, CFO or finance team.
prompt.definition: At larger companies the finance function exists, is drowning, and evaluates the tool. Only scored for mid-size and larger companies.
yes_when: Someone on the team has a finance leadership title
no_when: A team list is shown and no one is in finance
watch_out_for: Advisors and board members don't count

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.

queries: "{company}" CFO OR "Head of Finance" OR Controller

examples.input_excerpt: Leadership: Maria Chen, CEO; David Ross, VP Finance

output.reason: A VP Finance is on the team.
